_README: Games a reviewer actually read, keyed by game id. Consumed by
tools/card_coverage.py, which UNIONS this with the game ids cited in
CLAUDE.md prose.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (Aug 10, 2026). Until now 'reviewed' was derived
purely from ids cited in CLAUDE.md, which worked only because every wave
happened to be written up as a matchup ledger listing each game. The Aug
10 CARD-TARGETED wave was written up by FINDING instead, and cited zero
ids -- so its 12 games silently read as unreviewed and the index began
recommending them for re-reading. Two of its top six suggestions were
games that wave had already read; the transform one listed nine 'novel'
cards, seven of which were that reviewer's own reported findings.
So: prose citation is a side effect of a formatting convention, not a
record. Record ids HERE at the end of every wave, whatever shape the
write-up takes. CLAUDE.md stays a source so the 137 historical games keep
counting without a backfill.
This does NOT track per-card status -- see data/card_review_ledger.json,
which puts individual cards back into the pool when a fix postdates the
logs (`awaiting`) or the ability never fired (`unexercised`). A game being
listed here does not mean every card in it was checked.
confidence: `recorded` = written down at the time. `recovered` = matched
forensically after the fact against the cards each reviewer reported
findings on. Recovered entries are evidence, not proof; the note says what
the evidence was.
